actions.description: Directly create a confirmed booking against a profile
actions.name: create-booking

profileId.description: Profile ID of the booking page. Example: "f4f38519-6e5c-45f2-9897-555960aae524"

startsAt.description: Booking start time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z"

endsAt.description: Booking end time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-15T11:00:00Z". The API may calculate this automatically based on profile settings.

timeZone.description: Time zone for the booking. Example: "America/Los_Angeles"

answers.description: Answers matching the profile questions codes

noShow.description: Whether the booking is marked as no-show

title.description: Display title for the booking page. Example: "My Booking Page"

subdomain.description: Unique URL slug for the profile. Example: "my-page"

description.description: Description shown on the booking page.

locale.description: Language locale for the profile. Example: "en-US"

bookingId.description: The unique identifier of the booking to delete. Example: "abc123"

actions.description: Get a single booking by id.
actions.name: get-booking

bookingId.description: The ID of the booking to retrieve. Example: "123"

actions.description: Get full configuration for a single booking-page profile — intake form questions, team members, appointment types, working hours, payments, cancellation policy, and automated actions.
actions.name: get-profile

profileId.description: The ID of the booking-page profile. Example: "f4f38519-6e5c-45f2-9897-555960aae524"

subdomain.description: Unique URL slug for the profile.

code.description: Field identifier referenced by booking answers. Example: "FNAME"

name.description: Display name of the appointment type.

numberOfSlots.description: How many contiguous slots are booked.

maxNoticeDays.description: Maximum days ahead a booking can be made.

minNotice.description: Minimum notice required before a booking.

allowed.description: Whether the booker can cancel or reschedule.

limitMinutes.description: How many minutes before the appointment changes are allowed.

reasonRequired.description: Whether a reason must be supplied.

offsetMinutes.description: Delay relative to the anchor in minutes.

actions.description: List booking-page profiles on this account.
actions.name: list-profiles

startsAt.description: Updated start time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-07-30T09:00:00Z"

endsAt.description: Updated end time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-07-30T10:00:00Z"

syncs.description: Sync booking-page profiles on this account.
syncs.name: profiles
